title: Adaptive Budget Allocation for Smart-Contract Fuzzing: Why Online Feedback Fails to Improve Vulnerability Triage
abstract: arXiv:2611.22430v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smart-contract fuzzing campaigns share a finite budget and vary widely in the execution cost of a first correct-class vulnerability report. Using trace replay on 143 annotated and 350 bug-injected contracts, we test whether online feedback improves triage. At a mean budget of 100 executions per contract, uniform allocation reaches 72% and 70% of the respective clairvoyant optima. All eight online policies trail uniform on aggregate triage, as do the seven repeated on the bug-injected corpus. Five online signals yield ranking AUCs of 0.32-0.51 for imminent reports. Synthetic-oracle experiments show that sufficiently accurate detection-cost estimates recover more of the gap than detectability rankings. This motivates an offline probability-curve allocator that predicts first-report probabilities across budgets and allocates by predicted gain per execution. In a frozen evaluation on four fresh seeds per corpus, detection-budget AUC improves

translated_title: 智能合约模糊测试的自适应预算分配：为什么在线反馈无法改进漏洞分类
translated_abstract: 智能合约模糊测试活动共享有限的预算，而首个正确类别漏洞报告的执行成本在各合约间差异很大。通过对143个带标注合约和350个注入漏洞合约进行轨迹重放，我们检验在线反馈是否能够改进漏洞分类。在每合约平均100次执行的预算下，均匀分配分别达到各自预知最优值的72%和70%。全部八种在线策略在总体分类表现上都不及均匀分配，在漏洞注入语料库上重复测试的七种策略同样如此。五种在线信号对即将出现的报告的排序AUC仅为0.32-0.51。合成预言机实验表明，足够精确的检测成本估计比可检测性排序能够弥补更多的性能差距。这启发了一种离线概率曲线分配器，它预测各预算水平下的首次报告概率，并按每次执行的预测增益来分配预算。在每语料库使用四个新鲜种子的冻结评估中，检测预算AUC得到提升。
tldr: 该论文发现智能合约模糊测试中的在线反馈策略均无法超越均匀预算分配，并提出一种基于离线概率曲线预测首次报告概率、按每次执行预测增益分配预算的分配器来改进漏洞分类效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that all online feedback policies fail to outperform uniform budget allocation in smart-contract fuzzing triage, and proposes an offline probability-curve allocator that predicts first-report probabilities across budgets and allocates budget by predicted gain per execution.
